name: Bitmart
rootCause: Is CeFi any safer than DeFi? If not, why use it? BitMart has lost $196M, placing it at number 2 on our leaderboard. Will they commit to refunding their users?

descriptions.text: Is CeFi any safer than DeFi? If not, why use it? BitMart has lost $196M, placing it at number 2 on our leaderboard. Will they commit to refunding their users?

BitMart founder and CEO Sheldon Xia tweeted to admit that a large-scale security breach occurred on the platform, and hackers were able to extract assets worth about US$150 million. The affected ETH hot wallet and BSC hot wallet carry a small amount of assets on BitMart, and the other wallets are safe and undamaged.

On December 4, 2021, BitMart suffered a compromise of its Ethereum and Binance Smart Chain hot wallets, resulting in losses of nearly $200 million in crypto assets, largely through the theft and laundering of ERC-20 and BEP-20 tokens after a stolen private key was used to access these wallets. Attackers obtained and used a private key for BitMart's Ethereum and Binance Smart Chain hot wallets, allowing them to transfer funds out of the exchange's custody. There is no published evidence of how the key was stolen.
